purpose.summary: This is a batch COBOL program (ORCBM029) that is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt billing software. It processes national health insurance and public expense (Kokuho/Sōkatsu) monthly billing summary reports for medical and dental departments (HCM2M/HCM2N forms). It reads claim/receipt data, aggregates statistics by insurance type and public expense category, and produces printed output.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

verdict.notes: The file is decoded as latin-1 but the Japanese comments are actually encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the open-source ORCA project maintained by JMA (Japan Medical Association), with a long revision history from 2003 to 2016. The source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~99443 bytes total, so the full PROCEDURE DIVISION logic is not visible, but the structure is unambiguous.
